Package domain

Class Goal

java.lang.Object
domain.Goal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Goal extends Object implements Serializable
Goal area of one side. The posts and the crossbar are static bodies in the physics library; this class only knows when the ball is inside.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
